tagline: International association representing European inland navigation sector interests
hero_kpi_rationale: IVR is a non-profit association without measurable commercial activity. In 2024, the organization mobilized over 225 participants at its annual congress and 80 participants at the first Loss Prevention Colloquium, reflecting member engagement and the impact of its institutional representation and knowledge-sharing activities.

kpis.name: Annual Congress Participants
kpis.explanation: Total number of participants at the IVR annual congress reflecting member engagement and sector representation.
kpis.description: The annual IVR Congress held in Frankfurt am Main from May 15-17, 2024, attracted 225 participants representing 11 different European countries. This represents a key engagement metric for the association's institutional activities.
kpis.signal: 225 participants from 11 countries attended the 2024 Frankfurt congress (May 15-17), demonstrating strong member engagement across multiple European nations.

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Participants
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium reflecting knowledge-sharing initiatives within the inland shipping sector.
kpis.description: The inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium took place on November 4, 2024, in Antwerp at the Botanic Sanctuary, bringing together 80 professionals from Belgium, the Netherlands, and Germany to discuss technical and financial aspects of loss prevention in European inland navigation.
kpis.signal: First edition of Loss Prevention Colloquium held November 4, 2024 in Antwerp with 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany, establishing a new recurring knowledge-sharing platform.

kpis.name: Countries Represented
kpis.explanation: Geographic scope of IVR membership spanning multiple European inland navigation jurisdictions.
kpis.description: IVR represents the interests of the European inland shipping sector across multiple countries. The 2024 Annual Congress demonstrated representation from 11 different European nations, underscoring the association's international scope and relevance.
kpis.signal: The 2024 congress brought together members and partners from 11 different European countries, confirming IVR's pan-European reach and institutional significance.
